doc: The look-alike drill (#228): set keys (`keys`), the set file format and its first problem (`files`), and which sets a learner practises (`candidates`). README.md.

keys.name: the prolonged sound mark (not a kana letter)

files.name: a character of two code points
a Latin letter as a character
pinyin and bopomofo of different lengths
a traditional example without the character
an example with the character twice
a kana in the wrong script
a kana pair in the same script
the same members twice, in another order
a script on a Japanese set
a note of a character not in the set
marks of a character not in the set

candidates.name: a word with a member brings its set
a simplified workspace takes the Hans and unmarked sets
a traditional workspace takes the Hant and unmarked sets
in the order of the first studied member, each set once
Japanese kana sets always, first, in file order
then the kanji sets of the studied words
a file of another language gives nothing
